name: Omalava
author: Gavin Nugent
description: A live liquid-motion-lamp wallpaper for omarchy-shell, generated on the fly: wax warms on the heater, climbs out of the pool in columns, necks, breaks, rises, cools and sinks back. A metaball field drawn by a GPU shader and moved by a small physics simulation seeded fresh every start, so it never loops. Follows your Omarchy theme or one of six palettes, one lamp per monitor, freezes under fullscreen windows. Bar widget, or: omarchy-shell omalava <on|off|toggle|...>

barWidget.description: Turn the lamp on and off, pick a palette, set speed, blobs and size.
